forum.best_answer_content:
The solution to this was simple!

I started chatting with ​@Ulysses HERNIOSUS to understand and sort the confusion in my mind about information I had found in different discussions/questions.

During this I checked for any update on  [STSW-ST25PC001](https://www.st.com/en/embedded-software/stsw-st25pc001.html) and luckily there was one tagged as v3.2.0

So immediately I downloaded it and extracted the DLLs and integrated with my project and it was an effortless upgrade to x64.
forum.content_text:
This is not a real question, this is just knowledge sharing…

For the context, I would read

<https://community.st.com/st25-nfc-rfid-tags-and-readers-54/c-application-for-steval-25r3916ba-using-st25r3916discocomm-dll-130797>

first.

At this point I had x86 NFC Tag Programming application, I have been waiting for the STM to release x64-bit version of the DLLs so I could update my application to x64.

I have been lurking around the community and finally found

<https://community.st.com/st25-nfc-rfid-tags-and-readers-54/is-there-a-64-bit-version-of-st25r3916discocomm-dll-130037>

but this did not help as with the release of v3.0.0, it did came with x64 bit of DLLs but I had real hard time integrating them into my project!! Quite disappointing, eh?!!

I gave up the idea of updating my application to x64 until very recently I stumble upon another question

<https://community.st.com/st25-nfc-rfid-tags-and-readers-54/st25r3911discocomm-dll-64-bit-143584>

based on the question title, I clicked on it with a lot of hope and what I found was quite disappointing.

Basically I felt I was in a ditch where I could not update my application to x64 even though I have x64 bit DLLs!
